shares of Common Stock that were issued in August 2026 to two consultants as compensation for services. Those shares are already
outstanding, and their resale will not increase the number of shares of Common Stock outstanding or change our net tangible book value.

Operating cash flow was −$21.1M. Working capital and other items used $35.7M.
